title: 6/16/2026 | Kevin Kennedy | COM | Comments regarding Commission consideration of American Stewards of Liberty's Motion to Defer Determination of Need

documents.text:
=== 59475 - Kennedy comments on ASL motion (2026-06-16).pdf ===
June 16, 2026

Re:    Motion to Defer Determination of Need
       PUC Docket Nos. 59029, 59182, 59315, 59336, 59475

Chairman Thomas Gleeson and PUC Commissioners
The Public Utilities Commission of Texas
1701 Congress Ave.
Austin, TX 78701

Chairman Gleeson and Commissioners Jackson, Hjaltman, Morgan and Rhode,

As the pro se landowner intervenor who brought the Commission the successful motion to
consolidate on 59182 and 59475, I respectfully urge the Commission to grant the motion to defer
determination of need made by the American Stewards of Liberty.

The Commission and ALJs have partially granted the ASL motion with the previous order to
consolidate the decision on need for Import Path 2 segments 59182 and 59475. Import Path 1
segments 59029 and 59315 should have likewise been consolidated, as required by PURA 37.0541.
Landowner intervention should not have been required to force compliance with 37.0541 for
consolidation of 59182 and 59475. Likewise, landowner intervention should not now be required to
force compliance with 37.0541 for consolidation of 59029 and 59315. The Commission should act
to require consolidation of the decision on need for 59029 and 59315, irrespective of whether the
Commission approves the ASL motion or not. That was and still is required for 37.0541
compliance.

The ASL motion then becomes a very minor request and a small step that will lead to a better
examination of the now questionable analysis and recommendations of the Permian Basin
Reliability Plan. The Commissioners must ensure they have all the information necessary to make
the best decisions for the rate payers, landowners and citizens of this great State. Without taking this
discretionary action to allow greater scrutiny, the Commission risks making the wrong decision.

Again, I respectfully urge the Commission to grant the motion to defer determination of need made
by the American Stewards of Liberty.

Respectfully submitted,

/s/ J. Kevin Kenendy
Kevin Kennedy
630 County Road 282
Bertram, Texas 78605
Phone: 512-639-1720
Email: jkkennedy.tx@gmail.com
